title: Clinical-Protocol-Aware Cyber Resilience for Connected Clinical Technologies Under AI-Enabled Adversarial Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2610.41784v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Healthcare increasingly relies on connected medical devices, clinical information systems, cloud services, and distributed-care technologies, creating cybersecurity risks across clinical workflows. AI-enabled capabilities can accelerate vulnerability discovery and attack-path analysis, increasing the need to limit compromise propagation. This paper proposes a clinical-protocol-aware cyber-resilience framework based on bounded clinical micro-networks and controlled interconnections. The framework integrates clinical factors into cybersecurity design, management, and evaluation, covering prevention, containment, and incident response. A parameterized Monte Carlo simulation distinguishes technical cyber exposure from modeled clinical consequence. Experiments investigate architectural connectivity, adversarial capability, security controls, protocol dependency, risk alignment, communication directionality, lifecycle integration, and response

translated_title: 面向联网临床技术在AI赋能对抗条件下的临床协议感知网络韧性框架
translated_abstract: 医疗保健日益依赖于联网医疗设备、临床信息系统、云服务和分布式诊疗技术，这在临床工作流程中带来了网络安全风险。AI赋能的能力可以加速漏洞发现和攻击路径分析，从而进一步增加了限制入侵扩散的需求。本文提出了一种基于有界临床微网络和受控互连的临床协议感知网络韧性框架。该框架将临床因素整合到网络安全的设计、管理和评估中，涵盖预防、遏制和事件响应。通过参数化的蒙特卡洛模拟，将技术性网络暴露与建模的临床后果区分开来。实验研究了架构连接性、对抗能力、安全控制、协议依赖性、风险对齐、通信方向性、生命周期集成和响应等方面。
tldr: 本文提出了一种将临床协议因素融入网络安全设计、管理与评估的临床协议感知网络韧性框架，通过有界临床微网络和参数化蒙特卡洛模拟，在AI赋能对抗条件下限制入侵扩散并区分技术暴露与临床后果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a clinical-protocol-aware cyber-resilience framework that integrates clinical factors into cybersecurity design, management, and evaluation, using bounded clinical micro-networks and parameterized Monte Carlo simulation to limit compromise propagation and distinguish technical cyber exposure from clinical consequences under AI-enabled adversarial conditions.
